statements.status_notes: CVE-2021-23463 is an XXE issue in org.h2.jdbc.JdbcSQLXML when getSource(DOMSource.class) is invoked, fixed in H2 2.0.202. Runtime LINSTOR uses H2 2.4.240 on the classpath (https://github.com/LINBIT/linstor-server/blob/v1.35.2/build.gradle#L134). The flagged 1.4.197 jar is outside the runtime classpath under lib/migration (https://github.com/LINBIT/linstor-server/blob/v1.35.2/build.gradle#L372-L389, https://github.com/LINBIT/linstor-server/blob/v1.35.2/build.gradle#L477-L478) and is only loaded when an operator explicitly runs linstor-database migrate-h2 against local pre-2.x database files. That migration path reads operator-controlled H2 store files and does not exercise JdbcSQLXML.getSource(DOMSource); the controller and satellite never load the 1.4.197 jar during normal operation.

CVE-2022-23221 is an H2 Console remote code execution issue via crafted jdbc:h2:mem URLs, fixed in H2 2.1.210. Runtime LINSTOR uses H2 2.4.240 (https://github.com/LINBIT/linstor-server/blob/v1.35.2/build.gradle#L134). The flagged 1.4.197 artifact is the off-classpath migration jar under lib/migration used only by linstor-database migrate-h2 (https://github.com/LINBIT/linstor-server/blob/v1.35.2/build.gradle#L372-L389, https://github.com/LINBIT/linstor-server/blob/v1.35.2/build.gradle#L477-L478). That utility does not expose the H2 Console, so the Console RCE path is not reachable in this image.

CVE-2021-42392 is an H2 Console JNDI remote class-loading issue fixed in H2 2.0.206. Piraeus Server / LINSTOR uses H2 2.4.240 on the controller runtime classpath (https://github.com/LINBIT/linstor-server/blob/v1.35.2/build.gradle#L134). The flagged 1.4.197 jar is shipped only under lib/migration for the optional linstor-database migrate-h2 tool that reads pre-2.x database files and is deliberately kept off the runtime classpath via the h2v1migration configuration (https://github.com/LINBIT/linstor-server/blob/v1.35.2/build.gradle#L372-L389), staged into lib/migration (https://github.com/LINBIT/linstor-server/blob/v1.35.2/build.gradle#L477-L478). The H2 Console is not started by the controller, satellite, or migrate-h2 path, so the Console attack surface is not reachable.
